thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: high error rate observed for /v1/generate (5xx spike). Alert threshold 200 errors/min. Correlation IDs present in logs.

eric_oncall: I'm on it, looking at dashboard. Can someone paste KV logs?

maria_sre: pulling traces now. initial hypothesis: upstream retry amplification from model-proxy. seeing lots of `retry_count: >3` for same request ids.

ingrid_prod: Customer impact: several active sessions reported timeouts; CS Julie seeing increased tickets. Julie, can you confirm affected customers?

cs_julie: 3 customers (acct-42, acct-77, acct-824) reported timeouts ~12:03-12:10 UTC, all on eu-west region.

eric_oncall: ok, timeline: spike started 2639999950, peak ~2639999985. Root cause unknown. Maria/high-pri trace share next.

maria_sre: sharing quick KV log excerpt for correlation id 0xabc123:
```
[12:04:21.785] request_id=0xabc123 gateway -> model-proxy: upstream 504, retry=1
[12:04:21.786] request_id=0xabc123 gateway -> router: queued for retry, backend=model-proxy
[12:04:22.102] request_id=0xabc123 gateway -> model-proxy: upstream 502, retry=2
[12:04:22.403] request_id=0xabc123 gateway: final 502 -> client
```

maria_sre: full KV logs uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/2639999999/kvlogs.tar.gz (private link).

devops-bot: Deploy bot: recent deploy to model-proxy service at 2639999700. Rollout completed 2639999770.

tim_runtime: Noted. Could be a change in model-proxy's retry policy + latency regression causing retry storm. I'm checking kernel oom and busy threads.

eric_oncall: Mitigation option A: temporarily reduce client-side retries at gateway from 3 -> 1 to break amplification. Option B: route traffic to fallback model-1-small variant. Which to do first?

ingrid_prod: Do A first, faster to push config. B requires model warmup and may increase latency.

maria_sre: Agreed. Pushing gateway config to reduce retries now. Command: `kubectl set env deploy/gateway RETRY_MAX=1 -n prod`

devops-bot: Command executed by maria_sre at 2639999999: `kubectl set env deploy/gateway RETRY_MAX=1 -n prod` -> rollout started.

eric_oncall: Observing metrics... error-rate dropping from 220/min -> 95/min over last 30s. Keep watching.

maria_sre: Also toggled per-route circuit-breaker to fail fast for model-proxy (concurrency limit 25).

tim_runtime: Traces show tail latency from model-proxy increased 4x post-deploy 2639999770. Kernel not OOM. Likely regression in connection pooling.

ingrid_prod: Customer impact update: tickets stabilized for acct-42 and acct-77. acct-824 still seeing intermittent timeouts.

maria_sre: Next steps: 1) keep reduced retry in prod for 30m, 2) open a rollback PR for model-proxy deploy, 3) gather full request logs for correlation ids in 2639999950-2639999990 window.

eric_oncall: I'm creating incident RCA thread and will hand off to runtime team for in-depth root cause. Tim, can you lead the rollback PR?

tim_runtime: On it. I opened PR #4021 to revert model-proxy change and pinned to previous image sha sha256:deadbeef at 263999. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/4021

devops-bot: Rollback PR merged by tim_runtime at 2639991005, and rollout started.

eric_oncall: Final check: error rate down to baseline (20/min). Marking incident as mitigated. Starting RCA doc — we'll include timeline, KV log links, affected customers, and hypothesis: retry amplification caused by model-proxy latency regression introduced in recent deploy.

maria_sre: Please collect any stray correlation IDs and upload traces to incident S3 path. Also schedule a postmortem call at 15:00 UTC.

cs_julie: Notified affected customers with interim status at 12:20 UTC.

eric_oncall: Thanks team. Handoff complete to runtime for root cause and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
